name: zanker-stack-sandbox
description: Render real React/Vite components or standalone HTML in project-local isolated host.

workflow.instruction: Run `bash ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/inspect.sh --project PROJECT` to identify stack and global style entries.
Prepare via `bash ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/sandbox-prepare.sh --project PROJECT --entry src/MyCard.tsx --styles src/index.css --wrapper src/SandboxProviders.jsx --scenarios fixtures.json`.
Review the generated workspace and ask permission to execute target code.
Start via `bash ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/sandbox-run.sh --project PROJECT --id mycard --allow-execution`; inspect states and viewport controls.
Run screenshot audit on local URL; use project-native environment for unsupported stacks or SSR components.

acceptance: No synthetic visual replacement of real component
fallback: Attach to framework-native dev server and audit rendered route.
